test_GTestEnvVarTest_testEnvVarAffectsFl: test that environment variables affect the corresponding Google Test flags like break_on_failure and color
test_GTestEnvVarTest_testXmlOutputFile: test that the XML_OUTPUT_FILE environment variable affects the output flag for XML test results
test_GTestEnvVarTest_testXmlOutputFileOv: test that GTEST_OUTPUT environment variable overrides XML_OUTPUT_FILE for controlling XML output file path
run_SetEnvVar: run SetEnvVar to set or unset an environment variable in the test environment dictionary
run_GetFlag: run GetFlag to execute the gtest_env_var_test_ binary and retrieve its output for a given flag
